waste_type: General Household Garbage, Dry Recyclables, Food Compost
special_instructions: Place rolling bins curbside by 6:30 AM with bin handle facing the street. Flatten cardboard boxes and place inside the blue recycling container. Electronic waste is prohibited in curbside bins.
contact_information: Greenfield Waste Management Dept, Phone: (555) 019-4821, Email: waste-zonea@greenfield.gov

waste_type: General Trash, Glass & Plastic Recyclables, Yard Waste
special_instructions: Yard clippings must be bagged in brown biodegradable paper bags or tied in bundles under 4 feet length. Glass containers must be rinsed before disposal.
contact_information: Greenfield Waste Management Dept, Phone: (555) 019-4822, Email: waste-zoneb@greenfield.gov

waste_type: General Waste, Mixed Recyclables, Green Organic Waste
special_instructions: Lids must remain fully closed to prevent wildlife tampering. Severe winter snow routes may push collection to afternoon hours.
contact_information: Greenfield Waste Management Dept, Phone: (555) 019-4823, Email: waste-zonec@greenfield.gov

waste_type: Commercial Waste, Cardboard Bundles, General Refuse
special_instructions: Commercial dumpsters must have unobstructed rear alley access by 5:30 AM. Grease and hazardous chemicals require specialized commercial hazardous pickup.
contact_information: Greenfield Commercial Sanitation Bureau, Phone: (555) 019-4824, Email: commercial-waste@greenfield.gov

waste_type: General Garbage, E-Waste Drop-off, Single-Stream Recycling
special_instructions: Student move-in/move-out periods in May and August feature free bulk item curbside dumpsters along College Avenue.
contact_information: Greenfield Sanitation - Campus Liaison, Phone: (555) 019-4825, Email: waste-univ@greenfield.gov

waste_type: Industrial Non-Hazardous Scrap, Pallets, Solid Refuse
special_instructions: Industrial manifests required for bulk metal, timber, and non-toxic factory byproducts. Hazardous waste requires EPA Form 8700-12 certification.
contact_information: Industrial Waste Division, Phone: (555) 019-4826, Email: ind-sanitation@greenfield.gov

waste_type: Public Litter Cans, Marina Waste, Sorted Recyclables, Compost
special_instructions: Fish scrap disposal must use refrigerated dumpsters at Pier 4. Marine battery and oil disposal drop-offs located at Marina Maintenance Shed.
contact_information: Waterfront Sanitation Office, Phone: (555) 019-4827, Email: waste-waterfront@greenfield.gov

waste_type: Residential Refuse, Agricultural Organic Scrap, Recyclables
special_instructions: Long-driveway properties must bring containers to the state road access point. Bulk manure or organic farm waste must be composted on-site.
contact_information: Rural Sanitation Services, Phone: (555) 019-4828, Email: waste-rural@greenfield.gov

waste_type: Household Trash, Co-mingled Recycling, Yard Trimmings
special_instructions: Bi-weekly yard trimmings collected on alternate Thursdays during Spring and Fall months. Check annual green-bin calendar for exact dates.
contact_information: Greenfield Waste Management Dept, Phone: (555) 019-4829, Email: waste-zonei@greenfield.gov

area: Old Town Heritage District & Cobblestone Quarter
special_instructions: Due to narrow cobblestone streets, large rolling bins are prohibited. Residents must use official Greenfield Municipal Corporation blue and green approved bags.
contact_information: Heritage District Services, Phone: (555) 019-4830, Email: waste-heritage@greenfield.gov

waste_type: Municipal Solid Waste, Sterile Paper/Plastic Recyclables
special_instructions: Biohazard and medical sharps are strictly handled by certified biomedical disposal contractors and will NOT be collected in municipal bins.
contact_information: Corridor Environmental Services, Phone: (555) 019-4831, Email: waste-med@greenfield.gov
